intro.text: A type of greatshell from Aimia, commonly thought to have died out when Aimia was scoured. Until the chasmfiends were found, lanceryn were the last creatures known to grow large gemhearts.
A type of enormous greatshell from Aimia, once the Ancient Guardians who kept the Dawnshard beneath Akinah. Lanceryn are commonly thought to have died out when Aimia was scoured.

description.text: Their apparent loss dismayed gemheart harvesters: no other creature known to grow large gemhearts turned up until the chasmfiends were found.

Like all greatshells, lanceryn were enormous, and like today's larkin they could feed on Investiture. When they fell, the Sleepless took over guarding the Dawnshard. Hordelings that had interbred with lanceryn gained a weaker form of that ability.
A Sleepless says lanceryn are now called larkin, and believes the larkin Chiri-Chiri is an Ancient Guardian herself.
